paragraphs: Chanan the Hidden, son of Choni the Circle-Drawer's daughter, was accustomed to miracles: Taanit 23b. He would hide in the privy. Jerusalem Ketubot, chapter 2, says that they wished to appoint him a communal administrator, but he refused and hid himself. See Rashi in Taanit there, and another explanation in the Chiddushim in Ein Yaakov, after his burial; see there.
